title: Bound asynchronous work before it starts
goal: Bound async workflows or task starts while retaining batch results in input order.

selectionNotes: Pass cold workflows or task factories. Already-running tasks escape admission limits.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=11.0.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Compiled in stable F# 11 language mode.

constraints: Limits active operations, not total input/result storage; this is not a streaming or rate-per-second API. Start/completion order is arbitrary.

The task helper supplies a token to each factory; forward it to cancellable I/O. A sibling fault cancels the governing sibling token; multiple failures do not imply an AggregateException containing every failure.

The older semaphore sample preserves admission/order but does not implement all newer sibling-failure cancellation semantics. Focused execution checks successful admission/order for both async and task paths.

packages.name: FSharp.Core
packages.reason: FSharp.Core 11 is the library dependency for this edition; the exact compiled RC2 version is recorded separately in evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual FSharpAsync compilation and managed execution including bounded assertions; separate compiler/external-consumer probes in eng/Test-FSharpBoundaries.ps1. No mocks, cross-compilation, native/AOT deployment or GA execution claimed.
